title: Do Latent Tokens Think? A Causal and Adversarial Analysis of Chain-of-Continuous-Thought
abstract: arXiv:2512.21711v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Latent tokens are gaining attention for enhancing reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet their internal mechanisms remain unclear. This paper examines the problem from a reliability perspective, uncovering fundamental weaknesses: latent tokens function as uninterpretable placeholders rather than encoding faithful reasoning. While resistant to perturbation, they promote shortcut usage over genuine reasoning. We focus on Chain-of-Continuous-Thought (COCONUT), which claims better efficiency and stability than explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) while maintaining performance. We investigate this through two complementary approaches. First, steering experiments perturb specific token subsets, namely COCONUT and explicit CoT. Unlike CoT tokens, COCONUT tokens show minimal sensitivity to steering and lack reasoning-critical information. translated_title: 潜在标记会思考吗？对连续思维链的因果与对抗性分析
translated_abstract: 潜在标记因能增强大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力而备受关注，但其内部机制仍不清楚。本文从可靠性视角审视这一问题，揭示了其根本性缺陷：潜在标记充当的是不可解释的占位符，而非编码忠实的推理过程。尽管它们对扰动具有抵抗力，但它们促进的是走捷径而非真正的推理。我们聚焦于连续思维链（COCONUT），该方法声称在保持性能的同时比显式思维链（CoT）具有更好的效率和稳定性。我们通过两种互补的方法对此进行研究。首先，操控实验对特定的标记子集（即COCONUT和显式CoT）进行扰动。与CoT标记不同，COCONUT标记对操控表现出极小的敏感性，且缺乏推理所需的关键信息。其次，捷径实验在有偏和分布外的设置下评估模型。
tldr: 本文通过因果操控实验和捷径实验发现，连续思维链（COCONUT）中的潜在标记并非编码忠实的推理过程，而是作为不可解释的占位符，促使模型走捷径而非进行真正的推理。
en_tdlr: Through causal steering and shortcut experiments, this paper reveals that latent tokens in COCONUT function as uninterpretable placeholders rather than encoding faithful reasoning, promoting shortcut usage over genuine reasoning.
